key_terms.مَكْسَبَةٌ: earning, acquiring — something that brings about a result

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say about aloofness toward people?
ai.summary: This brief but profound saying, attributed through a chain of Kufan and Qummi transmitters to either Imam al-Baqir (AS) or Imam al-Sadiq (AS), warns against social withdrawal and coldness. The term 'al-inqibad' (انقباض) denotes contracting away from people — avoiding interaction, being reserved to the point of rudeness, or treating others with disdain. Such behaviour does not merely fail to build friendships; it actively cultivates enmity. This teaching reflects the Imams' consistent emphasis on warm, engaged social conduct as a religious duty.
